scope: P0 official acquisition and source-only protocol audit. No target model inference or target numerical GT scoring in P0.

official_availability_evidence.author: iris0329
official_availability_evidence.paraphrase: Collaborator states that other baselines were not released and other checkpoints were lost after the server reset.
Project page links to the same GitHub and HF repositories; no alternate Waymo-only checkpoint was found.

training_recipe.initialization: Pretrained local RoBERTa-base; visual backbone and grounding components initialized from code defaults, with no released mixed checkpoint and no pp_checkpoint.
training_recipe.text_encoder_parameters: frozen, but dropout remains active in train mode
training_recipe.point_input: 16384 XYZ points; use_color flag does not cause the effective single-object loader to return RGB/reflectance
training_recipe.sampling: Random subsampling, replacement when fewer than 16384 points
training_recipe.augmentation: Single-object item path does not invoke the defined geometric augmentation helper
training_recipe.lr_scheduler: MultiStepLR advanced each optimizer step. Script nominal epochs 25/26 become effective 26/27 because default warmup_epoch=-1 is subtracted.
training_recipe.source_validation_policy: Waymo only, every 10 epochs if eventually reauthorized; primary fixed epoch100, no target selection.
training_recipe.criterion: HungarianMatcher(1,0,2,soft_token=True), box/label/contrastive losses, eos .1, temperature .07; seed focal and all 7 heads supervised.

evaluation_contract.prediction: center XYZ + raw full size XYZ; no trained heading/yaw output
evaluation_contract.GT: Official loader first 7 fields only; raw extra fields are not additional Euler angles.
evaluation_contract.official_readout: GT target class -> synonym span -> positive_map; normalized query/text contrastive score at temperature .07, top1. Must disclose GT-class/span assistance.
evaluation_contract.round2_readout: Modified text-only first noun readout, not identical to original official evaluation.
evaluation_contract.size_handling: Original official eval clamps predicted size at 1e-6; preserve and count raw invalid sizes rather than abs correction.
evaluation_contract.metric: Seal predictions before isolated float64 7D OBB scorer; use scalar-converted yaw before trigonometry; preserve independent audit.
evaluation_contract.target_adaptation: Must not receive target numeric bbox. GT-class/span-assisted official readout is a separate explicit information condition, not fully unlabeled deployment.
